jobs.title: Counsel, Employment
jobs.location_raw: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description_text:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Legal at Brex

The Legal team helps the company grow responsibly, advocating for Brex and for the thousands of growing businesses we serve. We provide strategic advice and guidance to all Brex teams, protect Brex, advise on risk, and represent the company externally, negotiating with partners and interacting with regulators. jobs.title: Assistant Project Manager Pre-Construction, Solar-BESS
jobs.description_text:
What The Role Is

jobs.title: Test Planner and Manager
jobs.location_raw: Mountain View, CA; Tucson, AZ; Colorado Springs, CO; San Antonio, TX; Ogden, UT
jobs.description_text:
Dark Wolf is seeking a Test Planner and Manager (TPM) to join our Test & Evaluation (T&E) team. Serving as the critical bridge between commercial innovation and military adoption, the successful candidate will embed rigorous, defensible T&E requirements, milestone evidence, and iteration cadences into non-traditional acquisition pathways (CSOs, OTAs) across the full project lifecycle. In this role, you will design end-to-end test strategies and architectures by translating operational needs and capability claims into structured test plans, defining key Measures of Performance (MOPs) / Measures of Effectiveness (MOEs), Modeling & Simulation (M&S) vs. physical range methodologies, and data requirements. Acting as a key integrator, you will navigate regulatory gating (flight clearances, airworthiness, spectrum, safety, and cyber authorities) to secure early approvals while aligning commercial vendors, Program Managers, and Service test organizations to deliver decision ready evidence that accelerates military fielding. This position will require around 30% travel. Key responsibilities include but are not limited to: 

  • Designing end-to-end test strategies by translating operational needs and vendor capability claims into structured test plans. Define key Measures of Performance (MOPs), Measures of Effectiveness (MOEs), Modeling & Simulation (M&S) vs. physical range methodologies, and data requirements.

jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.description_text:
Who we are 

CloudKitchens helps restaurateurs around the world succeed in online food delivery - our goal is to make food more affordable, higher quality and convenient for everyone. 

We take underutilized properties and transform them into smart kitchens so they can better serve restaurateurs, customers and the neighborhoods they’re in. Every time we launch a new facility we create jobs in that neighborhood, and we’re proud to provide a wide range of cuisines and options for healthy food at an affordable price.

We're changing the game for restaurateurs whether they’re entrepreneurs opening their first restaurant all the way through to your favorite global quick-service restaurant chains.

 

What you'll do

This is a full-cycle sales role for a driven seller who thrives on building pipelines, developing relationships, and closing new business. As an Account Executive, you'll own the sales process from outbound prospecting through negotiation and close, identifying and converting restaurant operators into CloudKitchens partners.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Own the full sales cycle, from outbound prospecting and qualification through discovery, negotiation, and closing.
  • Build and manage your own pipeline through cold calling, cold emailing, field prospecting, and multi-channel outreach

jobs.title: Associate Creative Producer
jobs.description_text:
Who we are 

In the past, to be a successful restaurateur, you simply had to have a passion for food and a passion for people - but to succeed as a digital restaurateur you also need to have a passion for technology. We believe in the joy of serving others, and that's why we created Otter – to help restaurateurs succeed in online food delivery. Restaurants around the world, both large and small, including Chick-fil-A, Ben & Jerry’s, KFC, and Eataly trust our software to power their delivery business. We increase sales, reduce order issues, and decrease delivery headaches. 

 

What you’ll do

Testimonial Production

  • Coordinate with restaurant partners to produce video testimonials
  • Manage logistics: scheduling, locations, approvals, and communication
  • Coordinate shoots (in-person and remote) with videographers and operator

Social-First Content Creation

  • Create native, platform-first content for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, and other social channels.
  • Be comfortable getting behind or in front of the camera when the concept calls for it.
  • Bring a strong understanding of hooks, pacing, storytelling, trends, and what makes people stop scrolling.
  • Regularly pitch and execute new content concepts that feel authentic to the platform—not like traditional corporate marketing.

jobs.title: Construction Program Manager
jobs.description_text:
Who we are 

Lab37 Robotics, is a technology company focused on the development and deployment of robots designed specifically for direct-to-customer food production. Our mission is to revolutionize the food industry by creating innovative robotic solutions that enhance efficiency, quality, and customer satisfaction. We are passionate about pushing the boundaries of technology to deliver cutting-edge products that meet the evolving needs of our clients.

 

About the role

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description_text:
Who we are

Pronto AI is a global leader in commercializing autonomous vehicle (AV) technology, deploying Autonomous Haulage Systems (AHS) that automate operations in mines, quarries, and construction sites worldwide. While much of the industry remains in R&D, we deliver real, production-ready autonomy that is already operating in the field.

We are on a mission to make mining operations safer, smarter, and more efficient through cutting-edge technology, and we are building toward becoming the world’s first profitable AV technology company.

About the Role 

Pronto is looking for a highly organized and adaptable Project Coordinator to own scheduling and logistics across all customer sites. This person will be the central point of coordination for operators, field technicians, and site visits — building and maintaining schedules, arranging all employee travel, and keeping projects staffed correctly even as priorities shift and last-minute changes come in. They will also handle expense reporting for project-related travel, working closely with the Director of Program Management and the broader project team to ensure every site visit runs smoothly from planning through completion. 

This is a critical, high-visibility role: the Project Coordinator will be an integral part of the project team, directly responsible for making sure the right people are in the right place at the right time.

Solutions Architect — Autonomous Systems & Industrial Base

Role Overview

Defense Unicorns is seeking a Solutions Architect to work with autonomous systems manufacturers, Federal Systems Integrators, and commercial technology companies looking to deliver capabilities into the Federal defense market.

This role sits at the intersection of customer mission needs, complex hardware platforms, and modern cloud-native software. The Solutions Architect will facilitate technical and strategic conversations with customers and partners to understand their systems, identify integration opportunities, and define how cloud-native software, data transport technologies, and modern software deployment patterns can be incorporated into drones, satellites, weapons systems, and other mission-critical platforms.

The ideal candidate can move comfortably between executive-level conversations, system architecture discussions, and hands-on technical discovery. They should be able to translate mission and business requirements into practical architectures that account for constrained, disconnected, intermittent, and bandwidth-limited environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Facilitate technical discovery and architecture conversations with autonomous drone manufacturers, Federal Systems Integrators, defense technology companies, and mid-sized commercial companies pursuing federal opportunities.

Intern and Full Time roles - SDE, Data Science, AI/ML, Product Manager, UX, and more!

Location Details: Tempe, AZ or Remote USA

At GoDaddy the future of work looks different for each team. Some teams work in the office full-time, others have a hybrid arrangement (they work remotely some days and in the office some days) and some work entirely remotely. 

Hybrid-or-Remote:  This position may be a hybrid or fully remote position, as decided by your manager. If designated as hybrid, you’ll divide your time between working remotely from your home and an office location, so you should live within commuting distance. If designated as remote, you’ll be working remotely from your home and may occasionally visit a GoDaddy office to meet with your team for events or offsites. Your hiring manager can share more about this role’s hybrid or remote designation. 

This position is not eligible to be performed in Alaska, California, Colorado, Louisiana, Massachusetts, Mississippi, New Jersey, New York, North Dakota, Oregon, Seattle, WA, or the Virgin Islands.

Sponsorship
GoDaddy will not sponsor employment-based visas (e.g., candidates who now or in the future will require H-1B sponsorship) for this position at this level.

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Intern - Technical AI & Automation
jobs.description_text:
Eulerity is an AI-native marketing automation platform. Our software runs paid advertising, social, listings, reputation, and call tracking for thousands of locations across enterprise franchises and SMB networks, executing autonomously across Google, Meta, Apple, and Microsoft. The Technical Operations team is the analytical engine that keeps that execution sharp.

We are hiring an intern to sit with this team for the summer.

Who we are looking for

This is not just a marketing internship. We are looking for someone who is genuinely analytical. The kind of person who opens a messy dataset and gets curious instead of overwhelmed. Who enjoys figuring out why a number moved. Who can read a chunk of SQL or Python and follow what it does, even if they would not write it from scratch. Who would otherwise be heading toward an analyst seat at a consulting firm or a product role at a startup.

If you love spreadsheets, you will feel at home here. If you have ever built a model in Excel just to understand something better, even more so.

What you will actually do

You will work directly with our Technical Account Management and Analytics teams on the parts of campaign management that require thinking, not clicking. That includes:

Compensation: $17.00 – $20.00 / hour

Commitment: 20-40 hours/week

 

Position Overview

At Eulerity, we are building the future of AI-driven marketing automation. We simplify digital advertising for franchises and multi-location businesses , using machine learning and automation to help our clients scale. Behind every great startup is a rock-solid financial foundation, and our finance department is currently in a pivotal "0 to 1" phase regarding our financial infrastructure.

We are looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented intern to join our team in our New York office and support our financial operations from the inside. This is not a passive, administrative internship. jobs.title: Solutions Consultant
jobs.description_text:
About the Role

You'll own the technical and operational execution of the trial from kickoff to decision, acting as the connective tissue between Sales, Product, and the customer during the evaluation window. You'll be the single point of accountability for trial execution.

Key Responsibilities

  • Trial Execution: Own the technical and operational execution of each enterprise trial from kickoff through the customer's final decision, including environment setup and configuration.
  • Requirements & Scoping: Gather and scope technical and operational requirements directly with the customer's technical and legal ops stakeholders.
  • User Enablement: Design and deliver training so prospect teams can meaningfully evaluate the product, not just log into it.
  • Issue Triage & Escalation: Identify and triage issues that arise during the trial, escalating to Product or Engineering as needed to keep the trial moving.
  • Project Management: Own the trial timeline and success criteria, hold both Eudia and the customer accountable to them, and flag risk to the deal team early.
  • Cross-Functional Connective Tissue: Act as the primary link between Sales, Product, and the customer during the evaluation window, and translate trial outcomes into a clear, evidence-based case for close.

jobs.description_text:
At EQT, you won't just do a job, you'll help shape our future. Through Transparent Leadership, you'll work alongside leaders who value collaboration and ensure every voice is heard. Through Connected Impact, you'll see how your work influences critical business decisions and drives value across our operations. Through Supported Growth, you'll have opportunities to expand your skills through cross-functional collaboration, development opportunities, and career advancement.

Join our Qrew! 

Commodities Services supports EQT's commercial and trading organization through operational, reporting, and mid-office functions. This side of the team is heavily focused on analytics infrastructure and cross-functional data work: building and maintaining BI dashboards (Power BI, Spotfire), owning data pipelines feeding forecasting and reporting tools, triaging data/BI issues with IT Data Engineering, and producing the reporting and analysis packages used by trading and leadership to track pricing, P&L, and market exposure. The team also supports market data platform migrations and broader Commodities knowledge-sharing initiatives.

Join one of the fastest growing, most dynamic companies in the furniture industry. For over 25 years, Four Hands has been a leading designer and wholesaler of furniture and décor, helping people create spaces that feel like home. 

Recognized on the Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing companies and named one of Austin’s Top Workplaces year after year. We invest in exceptional people — with a team of over 800 and growing — fostering our employees’ careers and celebrating them at every step of the way. Four Hands is where passion meets purpose and where your next chapter begins.

The Photographer brings Four Hands’ creative vision to life through high-quality architectural lifestyle and e-commerce photography, partnering closely with stylists, photographers, producers, and studio teams to deliver consistent, on-brand imagery. This role combines strong studio lighting and product photography expertise with disciplined production management, ensuring shoots meet quality, volume, and deadline expectations while maintaining accurate digital asset management and technical standards. The Photographer also helps maintain studio equipment and workflows, supports the Photography Director and Production Manager, and contributes to a collaborative, solutions-oriented team environment with flexibility to support evolving business needs.

In This Role

  • Work closely with stylists and studio partners
